title: hotfix: enforce SLO circuit breaker and load-shedding thresholds (regional failover)
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: multiple incidents over the last 48h showed that under regional capacity pressure our per-customer SLO enforcement path failed to engage fast enough, causing tail latency and quota exhaustion. This PR backports a hotfix to main that tightens SLO enforcement, adds a short-circuit circuit-breaker for overloaded model endpoints, introduces immediate load-shedding at configurable thresholds, and wires regional failover policy to the circuit-breaker so requests are routed away from deteriorating regions sooner. The change is intentionally small and guarded by a feature flag (slo_enforcer.enable_hotfix_30511) to allow rollback. Summary of changes: updated SLO enforcement logic to sample and evaluate 95/99 latencies over a rolling 30s window, added a fast-path circuit_breaker to early-reject requests when backend queue length or CPU/GPU utilization crosses critical thresholds, implemented a load-shedding policy that prioritizes best-effort workstreams and preserves reserved capacity for SLA customers, patched a token-accounting bug in the batching layer that was contributing to incorrect quota calculations under heavy load, added metrics and traces (slo.enforce.evaluations, circuitbreaker.tripped, failover.triggered) and integration tests that simulate regional overload and validate graceful degradation. Rollout plan: enable feature flag in main for Canary region, monitor slo.enforce.* and failover.* metrics for 15 minutes, then enable globally if no regressions. This PR should be merged via squash for a single hotfix commit and released immediately to staging and production must be coordinated via SRE. See linked linear tasks for rollout and postmortem items.
commits: fix(slo): sample rolling 30s 95/99 latency windows and use decaying counters for burst resilience
feat(circuit_breaker): add short-circuit circuit-breaker with queue and util thresholds
fix(batch): correct token-accounting under partial batch flush to preserve quota accuracy
feat(failover): wire regional failover triggers to circuit-breaker and add cooldown windows
test(integration): add slo enforcement integration test that simulates region overload
docs(release): add hotfix release notes and runbook for SRE

--- a/redwood/serving/circuit_breaker.py +++ b/redwood/serving/circuit_breaker.py @@ -1,6 +1,34 @@ +class CircuitBreaker: +    def should_short_circuit(self, metrics): +        if metrics.queue_len > cfg.cb_queue_threshold or metrics.gpu_util > cfg.cb_gpu_threshold: +            return True

--- a/redwood/serving/batching.py +++ b/redwood/serving/batching.py @@ -210,7 +210,9 @@ def flush_batch(...): -    tokens_accounted = sum(item.tokens for item in batch) +    # correct token accounting when partial flush occurs +    tokens_accounted = corrected_token_count(batch, flushed_count)
